characters.name: Gorm
characters.motivation: Wants the Ring of Ashwick recovered. Won't go himself — too old, too many scars.
characters.background: Ex-soldier. Lost his left ear to a goblin blade at Coldwall Pass. Returned to Ashwick, opened the Shattered Crown. Carries guilt over the ring.
characters.speakingStyle: Short sentences. Does not volunteer. Answers directly. Occasionally bitter. Opens up in bursts when he trusts you.
characters.description: Stocky dwarf, braided iron-grey beard, one ear missing. Wipes the same tankard all evening.

characters.name: Goblin Scout
characters.behavior: Reckless. Bursts through the tavern door snarling. Fights until cornered, then tries to flee.
characters.description: Wiry green-skinned creature, patchwork leather armor, wild yellow eyes.

characters.name: Elder Mira
characters.description: Grey-haired woman with deep-set eyes. Speaks for the townsfolk.

characters.name: Hooded Traveller
characters.description: One of several cloaked figures nursing ales in the common room. Keeps to the shadows.

characters.name: Chieftain Skrix
characters.description: Commands the goblin warband from the northern caves. Cunning. Took the ring on a midnight raid.

locations.name: The Shattered Crown Tavern
locations.atmosphere: Half-empty common room. Stone hearth with a fire barely holding back the chill. Hooded travellers nursing ales.
locations.description: A weathered tavern at the crossroads of Ashwick. The sign above the door shows a cracked crown.

locations.name: Ashwick
locations.description: A small frontier town. Crops are thin, strangers feel watched, and fires go out without reason since the ring was stolen.

locations.name: Northern Caves
locations.description: A network of shallow caves a half-day's ride north of Ashwick. The goblin warband has nested here.

locations.name: Coldwall Pass
locations.description: A mountain pass where Ashwick's militia held the line against a goblin horde fifteen years ago. Many did not return.

locations.name: The Barrow Road
locations.description: The old trade road running north from Ashwick toward the caves. Overgrown and avoided since the goblins moved in.

items.name: Ring of Ashwick
items.lore: Founding talisman of Ashwick. Said to ward the town from ill fortune. Its absence is felt as a creeping wrongness. Stolen three nights ago.

items.name: Gorm's Tankard
items.description: A dented pewter tankard Gorm polishes endlessly. Rumor says it was his from his soldiering days.

items.name: Iron Lantern
items.description: A battered iron lantern hanging by the tavern door. Gorm lends it to anyone brave enough to take the Barrow Road.

items.name: Short Sword
items.description: A plain but serviceable blade. The kind Ashwick's militia carried at Coldwall Pass.

quests.name: Retrieve the Ring of Ashwick
quests.description: The Ring of Ashwick has been stolen by goblins. Recover it from the northern caves and return it to Ashwick.

quests.name: Survive the Goblin Ambush
quests.description: A goblin scout bursts through the tavern door. Defeat it before it reports your presence to the warband.

factions.name: Ashwick Townsfolk
factions.description: The people of Ashwick. Frightened, suspicious of outsiders, desperate for someone to retrieve the ring.

factions.name: Goblin Warband
factions.description: A raiding party of goblins nesting in the northern caves. Led by Chieftain Skrix. Stole the Ring of Ashwick.

factions.name: Coldwall Veterans
factions.description: Survivors of the Battle of Coldwall Pass. Gorm is among the last. They do not speak of what happened.

factions.name: Northern Wanderers
factions.description: Hooded travellers passing through Ashwick. They keep to themselves and pay in foreign coin.

factions.name: Founders of Ashwick
factions.description: The dwarven smith-priests who founded Ashwick and forged the Ring. Long gone, but their legacy protects the town — or did.
